A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the visual languages in the context sensitive classes are more expressive than those in the context free classes, and that the context free classes are more expressive (and more efficient) than those in the regular class.
the visual language hierarchy is a hierarchy of context sensitivity, where the context is the visual environment.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the visual language hierarchy provides a systematic way of classifying visual languages and of comparing different visual language specification methods.
visual languages are inherently more expressive than textual languages and that the cost of parsing visual languages will generally be higher than the cost of parsing textual languages.
